index.text440CharactersSupportsLetters: - 4-40 characters, supports letters, numbers, and symbols

Enter External QR values exactly as the label encodes them, including https://.
index.sixOptionalColumnsLetYou: Six optional columns let you onboard stock-room consumables (boxes, batteries, fasteners) and link individually-tracked assets to a reusable asset model:
index.theFirstRowIsUsed: The first row is used as column headers - it won't be imported
index.yourFileIsCheckedBefore: Your file is checked before anything is imported. If any row is invalid, nothing is created and you'll get a list of every problem to fix
index.needHelpPreparingYourFile: Need help preparing your file? Try our
index.useTheTemplateProvidedAbove: : Use the template provided above, or a file exported as Import-ready from the asset index. Any other file will produce corrupted data.
index.editYourAssetsInExcel: Edit your assets in Excel or Google Sheets, then upload the CSV here. We'll show you exactly what will change before anything is saved.
index.statusKitAndCustodyCant: Status, Kit, and Custody can't be bulk-updated via CSV, they have their own dedicated workflows elsewhere in Shelf. Tracking method is fixed once an asset is created. These columns will be safely skipped if present in your file.
index.ifAFieldCurrentlyHas: If a field currently has a value and you leave the cell empty, that value will be cleared. Fields that are already empty stay unchanged. Name, Description and boolean fields (Yes/No) cannot be cleared.
index.assetModelQuantityMinQuantity: Asset model, Quantity, Min quantity, Unit of measure, and Consumption type are never cleared by an empty cell, blanking them leaves the current value in place. Change these on the asset itself if you need to remove them.
index.lookingToCreateNewAssets: Looking to create new assets instead?
index.noNotesMatchYourCurrent: No notes match your current search or filter. <0></0>Try adjusting them to see more.
index.yourAssetHasNoNotes: Your asset `{{title}}` has no notes <0></0>attached to it.
index.uploadACsvFileTo: Upload a CSV file to create new assets. Start with our <0>CSV template</0> - each row becomes a new asset.
index.columnsLike0KitCategory: Columns like <0>kit, category, location & custodian</0> represent the name of the related entry - if it doesn't exist, we'll create it
index.eachRowCreatesA0: Each row creates a <0>new</0> asset - existing assets will not be merged or overwritten
index.toOnboardStockRoomConsumables: To onboard stock-room consumables (boxes, batteries, fasteners), or to link items to a reusable asset model, see <0>"Quantity-tracked assets"</0> below
index.prefixYourColumnHeadingWith: Prefix your column heading with <0>"cf: "</0> and add the type after a comma. Supported types:
index.ifNo0Qrid0: If no <0>"qrId"</0> is provided, a new QR code will be generated. Need unclaimed or unlinked codes? Contact support and we can provide them.
index.text0Step10Go: <0>Step 1:</0> Go to the <1>Asset Index</1>, select the assets you want to update, and export them. In the export dialog, choose the <2>Import-ready</2> format, it always includes the asset ID this tool needs to match rows to existing assets.
index.nameDescriptionCategoryLocationTags: Name, Description, Category, Location, Tags, Value, Available to book, <0>Asset model</0>, and your custom fields (Text, Boolean, Date, Option, Number, Currency).
index.text0AssetModel0Is: <0>Asset model</0> is matched by name (case-insensitive) and created automatically if it doesn't exist yet. It applies to <1>individually tracked assets only</1>, on a quantity-tracked asset the cell is skipped with a warning and the rest of the row still applies.
index.for0QuantityTracked0: For <0>quantity-tracked</0> assets you can also update Quantity, Min quantity, Unit of measure, and Consumption type. These columns are ignored on individually tracked assets.
index.by0AssetId0: By <0>Asset ID</0> or <1>ID</1>, keep these columns as they are. Categories, locations, tags, and asset models that don't exist yet will be created for you.
index.youCanUpdateUpTo: You can update up to <0>1,000 assets</0> per file. For larger batches, split your CSV into multiple files.
index.text0Tip0JustNeed: <0>Tip:</0> Just need to change one field on many assets? Select them in the <1>Asset Index</1> and use <2>Actions</2>, no CSV needed.
index.text0Type01Individual: <0>type</0> - <1>INDIVIDUAL</1> (the default if the column is missing or the cell is blank) or <2>QUANTITY_TRACKED</2>. On <3>update</3> imports, the cell is silently ignored - type cannot be changed once an asset exists.
index.text0Quantity0RequiredMust: <0>quantity</0> - required, must be a positive integer when <1>type = QUANTITY_TRACKED</1>. Ignored on <2>INDIVIDUAL</2> rows.
index.text0Minquantity0OptionalNon: <0>minQuantity</0> - optional non-negative integer; sets the low-stock alert threshold. Ignored on <1>INDIVIDUAL</1> rows.
index.text0Unitofmeasure0OptionalFree: <0>unitOfMeasure</0> - optional free-text label (e.g. <1>boxes</1>, <2>liters</2>, <3>kg</3>). Markdoc injection characters (<4>{</4>, <5>%</5>, <6>}</6>) are stripped.
index.text0Consumptiontype0RequiredWhen: <0>consumptionType</0> - required when <1>type = QUANTITY_TRACKED</1>. <2>ONE_WAY</2> (consumed on checkout, no return) or <3>TWO_WAY</3> (returned with a consumption report). Ignored on <4>INDIVIDUAL</4> rows.
index.text0Assetmodel0OptionalAsset: <0>assetModel</0> - optional asset model name; created automatically (case-insensitive lookup) if it doesn't exist yet. <1>INDIVIDUAL rows only</1> - on a <2>QUANTITY_TRACKED</2> row during update, the cell is skipped with a warning and the rest of the row still applies.
index.text0Tip0TheDownloaded: <0>Tip:</0> the downloaded template above already contains one <1>INDIVIDUAL</1> example with an <2>assetModel</2> and one <3>QUANTITY_TRACKED</3> example with <4>quantity</4> and <5>consumptionType</5> filled in.
index.text0HeadsUpOnQuantity: <0>Heads up on quantity columns:</0> this depends on the export format. <1>Import-ready</1> (recommended in Step 1) already includes Min quantity, Unit of measure, and Consumption type, and its Quantity cell is already a plain number, no changes needed before re-uploading. <2>Standard</2> writes Quantity as <3>10 boxes</3> when the asset has a unit of measure, strip the unit before re-uploading, or the row's quantity update fails, and has no separate Unit of measure or Consumption type columns at all; add those columns yourself using exactly those header names if you need them.
